title: Allow Securities Companies to Purchase the Government Treasury Bonds for 10% paid up Capital
text:
The Government of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar
Ministry of Planning and Finance
Securities and Exchange Commission of Myanmar
Instruction No.(9/20 I 6)
Allow Securities Companies to purchase the Government Treasury Bonds
for
l07o of paLd up Capital
19ft October2016
1. In accordance with the paragraph 2(c) of the Announcement No. (1/2015) of the
Securities and Exchange Commission of Myanmar, the securities companies have subscribed
the minimum paid up capital of MMK 15 billion. Regarding the paragraph 2(h) of this
Announcement, l07o of the paid up capital which is MMK 1.5 billion is allowed to purchase
government treasury bonds sold by the Central Bank of Myanmar starting from the Government
Securities Auction held on 20th September 2016,
2.
After the purchase of government treasury bonds, Securities Companies shall submit the
situation of purchasing, redeeming and additional purchasing to the Commission on time.
